resources.string: Your everyday tools in one place
Stops the screen from turning off. Your normal timeout comes back when you turn it off.
Locks media, ring, notification and alarm volume at their current levels.
Blocks all touches — great for videos or handing the phone to a child. Tap the lock 3 times to unlock.
Floats over any app: a stopwatch counting up from 0, or a countdown. Tap: start/pause · Hold: reset · Drag: move.
Allow \"Modify system settings\" for Sahl Tools, then come back
Allow \"Display over other apps\" for Sahl Tools, then come back
Tip: on Honor, set Sahl Tools to \"Manage manually\" in Battery → App launch so locks are not stopped.
Update failed — tap to try again
Turns the flashlight on and off from Quick Settings.
Makes the screen darker than the lowest brightness — easy on the eyes at night. Slide to choose how dark.
Switches Sound → Vibrate → Silent with one tap.
Allow Silent mode (Do Not Disturb access)
Scan any QR code or barcode, then copy, share or open it.
Point at a QR code or barcode
Paste links, share them here, or tap any link and choose Sahl Tools — it opens short links, removes tracking codes and checks the link for malware and phishing.
No link found. Copy a link first, or share one to Sahl Tools.
Removes location, camera and date details from photos before you send them. Clean copies go to Pictures/Sahl Clean.
Share photos to Sahl Tools, or use Pick photos.
%1$d clean photo(s) saved in Pictures/Sahl Clean
In any app, tap Share → \"Save to phone\" to save text, links or files wherever you choose.
Share something to \"Save to phone\" from any app.
Signal, speed, band, IP address, gateway and DNS of your current Wi-Fi.
Show the Wi-Fi name (needs location permission)
No warning signs found in this link
This doesn\'t look like a normal web link
Not secure (http) — anything you type can be seen
Uses a raw number address instead of a website name
Uses look-alike letters that can imitate a real site
Ending often used by scam sites
Contains @ — the real site is after it, not before
Short link that could not be opened — the real address is hidden
Mentions a well-known brand, but isn\'t that brand\'s site — possible phishing
Dangerous — %1$d of %2$d engines flagged it. Don\'t open it.
Scan is taking long — try again in a minute
Couldn\'t reach VirusTotal — check the internet
Free: sign up at virustotal.com, open your profile → \"API key\", copy it and paste it here. Saved only on this phone.
Paste one or more links here…
Short link opened to the real address
Sahl Tools needs the camera to scan. Allow it, then try again.
No hidden details found — a clean copy was saved anyway
Redirected %1$d time(s) — showing the real address
Add your free VirusTotal key to scan for viruses
Sahl Tools already checks every link you tap. You can change it here.
Next link will ask which app to use
Cleaned: %1$d tracking code(s) removed · %2$d characters shorter
VirusTotal checks links with about 90 antivirus engines. It is free — you only need a key once.
Create a free account (or sign in)
Open your API key page and tap the copy icon next to the key
Come back here — the key is pasted automatically. Tap Save.
No key on the clipboard yet — copy it first (step 2)
That doesn\'t look like a VirusTotal key (64 letters and numbers)
